scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns ordered prime pairs in a fixed two-block family and gives only the leading asymptotic. Finite computation checks the exact structural criterion on bounded examples but does not prove the infinite asymptotic. The proof of the asymptotic uses the published cyclotomic criterion together with standard prime distribution in fixed arithmetic progressions. Focused literature and database searches found no statement of the same density constant, but a differently phrased later corollary remains a residual originality risk.
title: Prime-pair densities for arithmetic numbers with two prime-power blocks
